findings.note: NBA.com's game log shows Zubac had 0, 1 and 1 assists in his last three games (Nov 9–13) while playing 26 to 31 minutes. His bigger minutes after the ankle injury have not led to more assists, which fits the Under 1.5.

ESPN lists his 2026-27 average at 1.6 assists per game over 8 games, just above the 1.5 line. He had 2 or more assists in 4 of those 8 games, including 5 in only 19 minutes against Denver on Nov 7 and 2 in a 7-minute game, so the line is close to a coin flip.

The Pacers' Nov 15 preview lists Zubac as the probable starting center, with Nembhard, Nesmith, Oubre and Siakam; Haliburton is not among the probable starters. Philadelphia's probable center is Jabari Walker. In the last meeting, Nembhard had 14 assists while Zubac was out.
